Third-party files used by the 3D avatar (kept here so the page works without a CDN):
  three.module.js, addons/*           three.js r170 (MIT license) https://threejs.org
  models/facecap.glb                  "Face Cap" head scan with the 52 ARKit blendshapes, from the three.js examples
                                      (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170/examples/models/gltf). Check its
                                      terms before redistributing the project publicly; fine for personal use.
